d:
After thousand years of entrapment, she was now free.
The Tarnished defeated all demigods and undid her seal.
Queen Marika returned. But she lost everything.
She planned to take everything back and avenged the person who sealed her.
But before that..., the Tarnished... needed to be reward.
***What would happen to the Tarnished after his journey ended? You'll find out here! 😎
